vendor_and_service: Public cloud provider (landing zone: ERP, FMS, backup accounts)
tier_rationale: Hosts the ERP (BP-01) and the FMS (BP-14); all company backups
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security, Availability, Confidentiality) plus bridge letter
subservice_organizations: None carved out for the services used
exceptions_noted: 1 exception: 2 of 60 sampled terminated employees' badge access removed late; remediated
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer configures identity, network rules, encryption keys, logging, and backups. Mapped to AC-2, SC-7, SC-12, AU-2, CP-9 in P04. Company gaps: FMS logs not monitored (POAM-019); full restore untested (POAM-005)
availability_vs_bia: Provider commitments are per service and region; company RTOs (ERP 24 h, FMS 8 h) depend on company recovery design, not the provider
incident_notification_terms: Provider notifies customers of security events affecting their data per its standard terms (no fixed deadline in the agreement)
bridge_letter: Bridge letter to 2026-09-30 obtained from the provider's portal
follow_up: Track the 2027 report; map provider commitments in the FMS system description as a carved-out subservice organization

vendor_and_service: Managed security service provider (MSSP; SYS-14 operator)
tier_rationale: Response rights on 640 endpoints; monitors every security source; supports detection for all processes
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security) plus bridge letter; annual service review with detection tests
subservice_organizations: SIEM platform carved out (the MSSP relies on the platform provider's own report)
exceptions_noted: 2 exceptions: high-severity escalation missed the 30-minute target in 2 of 40 samples; one analyst access review late. Management response: staffing added
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer must maintain escalation contacts, approve containment for plant-adjacent hosts, define log sources, and review monthly reports. Mapped to IR-4, SI-4, AU-2. Company gaps: MES, historian, Plant 2 OT, and FMS sources missing (POAM-007, POAM-019)
availability_vs_bia: Not a recovery provider; the MSSP's continuity plan for its operations center is tested annually per the report
incident_notification_terms: Contract: call within 30 minutes on high severity; no written breach notice term for the MSSP's own incidents
follow_up: Request the SIEM platform provider's SOC 2 (P01 R-015); add a 24-hour notice term for MSSP incidents; require 2-person approval for mass response actions

tier_rationale: Authenticates every user and administrator; a compromise reaches all systems
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security, Availability) plus bridge letter
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer configures MFA, conditional access, lifecycle automation, and break-glass accounts; reviews sign-in logs. Mapped to IA-2, IA-2(1), AC-2(1), AC-7. Company gap: push MFA on 23 privileged accounts (POAM-016)
availability_vs_bia: Service commitment 99.99% monthly; meets the BIA (break-glass accounts cover outages)
incident_notification_terms: Notice of security incidents affecting customer data within 72 hours (vendor terms)
follow_up: Obtain the hosting provider carve-out assurance

tier_rationale: Connects HQ, both plants, and the cloud; outages stop work order release (BP-01)
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security, Availability) or equivalent
opinion: Qualified for Availability (carrier failover testing did not operate for 3 months of the period)
exceptions_noted: Failover tests not performed March to May 2025; remediated per management
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer approves configuration changes and reviews monthly reports. Mapped to SC-7, SC-8, CP-8. Company gap: Plant 2 single wired carrier (P01 R-021)
availability_vs_bia: Provider target restoration 4 h for edge failures; meets the BIA 4-hour network recovery target only with cellular failover
follow_up: Ask for evidence that failover testing resumed; second wired carrier at Plant 2

tier_rationale: Carries purchase orders and ship notices for BP-11 and BP-12; holds pricing data
assurance_required: SOC 2 Type 2 (Security) or completed questionnaire with evidence
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer manages trading partner credentials. Mapped to SC-8, SA-9
availability_vs_bia: Outage tolerable 48 hours (BP-11 RTO); provider states 8-hour restoration
incident_notification_terms: No incident notice term in the contract
follow_up: Request a SOC 2 report or an independent assessment at the 2027 renewal; add a 72-hour incident notice term (POAM-012)

tier_rationale: Privileged support sessions into the ERP through the access broker
assurance_required: SOC 2 Type 2 (Security) for its support organization, or equivalent
report_type_and_period: ISO/IEC 27001 certificate for its support operations (valid to 2027-11); no SOC 2 report
opinion: Certificate only (no opinion on operating effectiveness)
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Company enables accounts per ticket and records sessions. Mapped to AC-17(1), AU-6. Company gap: session recordings not reviewed (P01 R-019)
incident_notification_terms: Notice of incidents affecting customers within 5 business days (support terms)
follow_up: Accept the certificate for now with session reviews; ask for a SOC 2 report at renewal

vendor_and_service: TMU electronics supplier (monitoring units and firmware)
tier_rationale: Its firmware is loaded into every power transformer and reaches utility substations
assurance_required: Product security questionnaire, secure development evidence, and firmware integrity process (SOC 2 does not cover product development)
report_type_and_period: Questionnaire completed 2026-08-25; supplier states it follows a certified secure development lifecycle; certificate requested
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Company verifies hashes on receipt and at final test (POL-01 4.8). Mapped to SI-7, SR-11, SR-6
incident_notification_terms: No deadline in the current agreement for vulnerability or compromise notices
follow_up: Add a 10-business-day advisory term and an SBOM requirement at renewal (POAM-012, POAM-017)

vendor_and_service: HR, payroll, and applicant tracking SaaS (SYS-16)
tier_rationale: Employee and applicant personal information; supports BP-17 (Low criticality)
assurance_required: Security questionnaire; SOC 2 report if available
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer configures roles, MFA, and features (the AI-005 match score was turned on without review). Mapped to AC-2, SA-9
incident_notification_terms: Breach notice within 72 hours (contract); Fla. Stat. 501.171(6) requires 10 days at most
follow_up: Feature-change notifications to the HR Director and Security Manager (P10)
